result.description: Conceptual desktop archival module for long-term document preservation and offline indexing. Designed for writers, researchers, and small studios that need quiet, low-power local storage with redundant mirroring and tamper-evident sealing. Includes encrypted vault folders, scheduled snapshot rotation, and a front status halo for activity and health indication. Not intended for gaming, graphics acceleration, or portable media use.
result.title: NovaQuill Lumen Archive Module
result.title_description: Desktop archival storage module for local document preservation
